### Executive Summary
Identity verification service provider IDScan has confirmed a data breach resulting in the compromise of sensitive customer information. 

According to initial reports, the incident involved the theft of more than 150 million driver's licenses from the company's systems.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The root cause of the security incident and the specific attack vector used by the threat actors are not yet confirmed.

The technical impact centers on the unauthorized exfiltration of critical personal identification data, specifically affecting over 150 million driver's license records managed by IDScan.

### Mitigation & IOCs
Recommended mitigations and response actions from the source are not yet confirmed. Affected organizations and individuals should monitor official communications from IDScan for guidance as the investigation develops.
